_comment: The files File Studio shares with Advanced Charts, copied verbatim into src/core/ by
scripts/sync-core.mjs. Paths are relative to the SOURCE repo. A file listed here is read-only
in this repository: fix it upstream, then re-sync, or the next --check will fail the build.
Kept to pure helpers on purpose. The Grist bridge is NOT shared: File Studio needs allowSelectBy
in its single ready() call and reads its table through onRecords (see docs/PLAN.md, 5.2).
